question: After the correctness, conflict, and proof blockers are cleared, should Workspaces ship as an opt-in bundled OpenClaw plugin with approval-gated custom widgets?
rationale: This PR adds a large durable user surface, agent tool contract, and security-sensitive browser execution model; implementation review cannot decide whether that product and maintenance commitment belongs in the bundled distribution.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in bundled plugin
options.body: Continue toward landing the current plugin-owned design after all findings, conflicts, and exact-head proof requirements are cleared.

options.title: Narrow or defer custom widgets
options.body: Land only the trusted built-in workspace surface, or defer the entire feature, if maintainers do not want to own agent-authored browser code yet.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in bundled plugin
recommendation.body: Continue toward landing the current plugin-owned design after all findings, conflicts, and exact-head proof requirements are cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the integration branch and the current-main plugin-tab and lifecycle seams, making him the strongest available routing owner for the product decision.
